Dry yesterday. 1.6mm in the last week. No frost this morning. Overcast with showers forecast from early morning and remaining through most of the day. 2-5C during the day with a fresh southerly breeze. Chase track verti drained last weekend. Watered to maintain GOOD ground. Watered to maintain GOOD
